APPOINTMENTS UNDER THE NOTARIES ORDINANCE

IT is hereby notified that the Hon. Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government, in terms of Section 11 of the Notaries Ordinance (Chapter 107), has made the following appointments with effect from February 21, 2025.
1. Mrs. Hene Kapuralalage Gayanjalee Nadeeprabha Gunasekara of No. 76A, Pahalagama, Gampaha, practicing as a Notary Public in Sinhala language within the judicial zone of Gampaha.
2. Mr. Sudarsha Pathirathna De Silva of No. 23C, Beddegana South, Pitakotte, practicing as a Notary Public in Sinhala language within the judicial zone of Colombo.
3. Miss. Weerahennedige Maheshika Nilmini of Serupita Janapadaya, Bolossagama, Kalutara South, practicing as a Notary Public in Sinhala and English languages within the judicial zone of Kalutara.
4. Mrs. Munasinghege Rangika Dilmini Munasinghe of No. 193/3, Main Road, Attidiya, Dehiwala, practicing as a Notary Public in Sinhala and English languages within the judicial zone of Colombo.
5. Mr. Rathnayake Mudiyanselage Sanath Gamini Bandara of No. 740A, Haliwela, Galle, practicing as a Notary Public in Sinhala language within the judicial zone of Galle.

6. Mrs. Widana Ralalage Damayanthi Darshani Ranathunga of No. 403/A, Egodawatte, Nailiya, Boyagane, practicing as a Notary Public in Sinhala and English languages within the judicial zone of Kurunegala.
